svg.title: Ягодичный мост с ногами на скамье — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Heels-elevated glute bridge, clear full side or side three-quarter view. Athlete lies on floor with head and shoulders on floor, BOTH heels clearly planted on top of a stable low flat exercise bench in front, knees bent, hands relaxed on floor. START pelvis on floor. FINISH pelvis raised so shoulders, hips and knees form an almost straight sloped line; same heels remain visibly planted on bench and shoulders on floor. Bench is under the FEET, never under back. Bodyweight only, no barbell or weights. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
